**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Resolve the installed executable in generated commands**

For installations performed by `install.sh`, the binary is placed under `$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/bin` and invoked there by absolute path, but that directory is never added to `PATH`. On a Codex- or Cursor-only setup where it was not already on `PATH`, these newly generated templates therefore execute a bare `cockpit` and `/prompts:cockpit` or `/cockpit` fails with `command not found`; generate the templates with the resolved executable path or install the binary into an advertised PATH directory. The Cursor template has the same bare invocation at lines 40-42.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve valid commented TOML table headers**

When an existing valid config uses a header such as `[tui] # native UI`, this check does not recognize the table because the trimmed line no longer ends in `]`. `upsertCodexStatusLine` then takes the fallback path and appends a second `[tui]` table, which TOML forbids; the resulting config fails Codex's `config.load` check and can prevent Codex from starting after `cockpit install codex`. Parse the TOML structurally, or at minimum handle valid trailing comments and other legal table/key spellings before appending a table.
